description: This Java class defines an immutable data object for extracting and representing flat loan collection sheet data for individual clients in a financial application, specifically within the context of a collection sheet report in Apache Fineract.

classes.name: IndividualCollectionSheetLoanFlatData
classes.description: An immutable data transfer object encapsulating all relevant loan data for an individual collection sheet entry, including client info, loan details, amounts due/paid, and related currency information.

methods.name: getClientName
methods.description: Returns the name of the client associated with this loan record.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the client.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the account ID associated with the loan.

methods.name: getAccountStatusId
methods.description: Returns the status ID of the account.

methods.name: getProductShortName
methods.description: Returns the short name for the product associated with the loan.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency data object associated with the loan.

methods.name: getDisbursementAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount disbursed for the loan.

methods.name: getPrincipalPaid
methods.description: Returns the amount of principal paid.

methods.name: getLoanDueData
methods.description: Constructs and returns a LoanDueData object encapsulating loan amounts and status.

methods.name: getClientData
methods.description: Constructs and returns a singleton IndividualClientData object with client ID and name.
